directions: Suppose you have read a book recently and intend to recommend it to other members of your book club via an online forum. Briefly introduce the book and explain why it is worth reading. You will have 30 minutes for this task and should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
sample_essay:
I'd like to recommend the book "The Alchemist" to you all. It's a captivating story that follows a young shepherd named Santiago on his journey to fulfill his personal legend.

To begin with, the book is filled with profound life lessons. For example, it teaches us that we should have the courage to pursue our dreams, no matter how difficult the path may be. Santiago overcomes many obstacles on his way to the pyramids, which shows us the importance of perseverance. 

In addition, the writing style is simple yet powerful. The author uses vivid descriptions to bring the story to life, making it easy for readers to immerse themselves in the world of the book. 

Furthermore, the book has a universal appeal. It doesn't matter what your age, gender, or background is, you can find something meaningful in it. 

In conclusion, "The Alchemist" is a must-read. It will not only entertain you but also inspire you to look for your own personal legend. So, don't miss out on this wonderful book.
